compression_level.description: Compression strength 1 (fastest/weakest) to 9 (slowest/strongest). Zst normalizes algorithm levels to this 1-9 scale.

algorithm.description: The compression algorithm to use. Must be one of: zstd, bz2, xz, gz.

keep_source.description: Whether to keep the original source file after compression or decompression.

force.description: Whether to overwrite existing files and allow writing to terminals if needed.

recursive.description: Whether to recurse into directories when processing file arguments.

stdout.description: Whether to write compressed/decompressed data to standard output.

verbose.description: Whether to list processed files and statistics.

files.description: List of file paths or glob patterns to compress, decompress, or test.
